zh.title: 吉隆坡機場自動通關看板改標TWN國旗未恢復
zh.summary: 吉隆坡國際機場自動通關看板改以TWN標示台灣，中華民國國旗未恢復。
body: 近期有台灣旅客在吉隆坡國際機場出境海關發現，護照自動通關看板改以「TWN」字樣標示台灣，與其他適用國家的國旗圖示並列，不過中華民國國旗並未恢復。
馬來西亞於2024年6月開放包含台灣在內的36個低風險國家與地區旅客使用出入境自動通關。吉隆坡國際機場看板上的中華民國國旗於同年12月遭遮蓋，當時馬來西亞外交部表示變更不影響台灣旅客使用自動通關資格。
針對相關標示調整，中央社於2026年8月12日詢問馬來西亞外交部與吉隆坡國際機場，截至發稿時尚未取得回覆。

en.title: Kuala Lumpur Airport Autogate Sign Updates Taiwan Label to TWN
en.summary: Kuala Lumpur International Airport updated its autogate signboard to label Taiwan as TWN without restoring the flag.
body: Travelers at Kuala Lumpur International Airport recently observed that the passport autogate signboard now identifies Taiwan using the designation TWN alongside flag icons of other eligible countries, though the Republic of China flag remains absent.

Malaysia expanded its autogate immigration facilities in June 2024 to include visitors from 36 low-risk countries and regions, including Taiwan. In December 2024, the Republic of China flag on the airport's signboards was covered, with Malaysia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs clarifying at the time that Taiwanese travelers retained autogate eligibility.

Central News Agency contacted Malaysia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Kuala Lumpur International Airport on August 12, 2026, regarding the signage adjustments, but received no response at the time of reporting.

zh.title: 卡達航空於杜哈至巴林航線部署空中巴士A350客機
zh.summary: 卡達航空於八月十二與十三日將空中巴士A350客機投入杜哈至巴林短途航線。
body: 卡達航空於8月12日與13日將空中巴士A350-900型客機投入其杜哈至巴林的航線營運。該航段距離約為90英哩，折合80海哩或150公里，屬於該機型營運歷史中最短的商業航線之一。
除了卡達航空外，其他航空公司亦在短途航線上部署此機型。衣索比亞航空執飛的日內瓦至里昂航段僅約60英哩，為目前最短的A350定期服務；新加坡航空與衣索比亞航空亦將A350-900部署於新加坡至吉隆坡航線。日本航空則在東京羽田至大阪、福岡與札幌等國內航線上營運A350-900機隊。
長途飛行方面，空中巴士為澳洲航空的「日出計劃」開發A350-1000ULR超長程機型。製造商於上個月將一架測試機從歐洲飛往澳洲，以進行相關測試計劃。

en.title: Qatar Airways Deploys Airbus A350-900 on Ultra-Short Doha-Bahrain Route
en.summary: Qatar Airways deploys an Airbus A350-900 on its short Doha to Bahrain route in August.
body: Qatar Airways is deploying an Airbus A350-900 on its Doha to Bahrain service on 12 and 13 August. The sector covers approximately 90 miles, or 80 nautical miles, representing one of the shortest commercial operations in the history of the A350 aircraft type.

Other operators also deploy the A350 on short flights. Ethiopian Airlines operates a 60-mile leg between Geneva and Lyon, marking the shortest scheduled A350 service. Additionally, Singapore Airlines and Ethiopian Airlines use A350-900s between Singapore and Kuala Lumpur, while Japan Airlines operates its fleet on domestic routes from Tokyo Haneda to Osaka, Fukuoka, and Sapporo.

For ultra-long-haul missions, Airbus developed the A350-1000ULR for Qantas' Project Sunrise initiative. As part of the flight test programme, the manufacturer flew a test aircraft from Europe to Australia last month.
